title: Epinephrine — Pediatric Cardiac Arrest

changelog.change: Initial entry aligned with Drug_Dosing_Peds_Weight_Based_Spec.md as the single source of truth.

purpose: IV/IO epinephrine dosing for pediatric cardiac arrest. Dose is computed live from the exact weight; the color zone supplies equipment sizes only, never this number.

doses.indication: Pulseless arrest (asystole / PEA / VF / pVT after shocks)
doses.notes: 0.01 mg/kg = 0.1 mL/kg of 0.1 mg/mL. Single-dose cap 1 mg.

rule.repeat: Every 3-5 minutes; establish IV/IO access as priority

doses.notes: ETT dose is 10× the IV/IO dose. Follow with 5 mL flush and 5 assisted breaths.

buildNote: Worked example of the dual-mode rule: the engine renders zone/equipment from weight-zones.json but every mg and mL here is computed from the entered weight. Cross-check against First 5 Minutes and PedsGuide before finalizing the full dataset (Tier 4).
